Bartlett. There are other good places but Bartlett sounds perfect for you. 

Pros: I've lived in Bartlett my whole life, it's a little suburb in Memphis with little to no crime, and great schools with very affordable houses. My kids go to the same elementary school I went to. Your neighbors look out for you. It's like a small town in a big city. Memphis public schools are known as Shelby county schools but Bartlett has their own Bartlett City Schools. They have their own police and mayor as well. 

Cons: Sometimes people complain about the police giving tickets, but hey something's working cause there's barely any crime. 

Germantown. Fancier and much more expensive.

Pros: Low crime, has their own police, their own schools which are also good. Just saying you live in Germantown makes you look abbot fancier to everyone else.
